about: Song / music-sequence veto for WHERE (checkpoint 7). song strength = music - speech_weight x speech (AudioSet classes); a song sequence = smoothed song strength >= threshold for >= min_song_sec; a break inside one is vetoed unless the music clearly pauses (song strength < pause_below within +/- pause_sec).

cpu_mode.note: free hosting without a GPU: score 10 s before and after each scene change only
